import fs from 'node:fs';
import { registerHooks, syncBuiltinESMExports } from 'node:module';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const sourceRoot = '<benchmark-workspace>/snapshots/pack-amber';
const runDir = '<benchmark-workspace>/iteration-1/eval-3-dirty-preflight/baseline/run-1';
const loadedFiles = new Set();
const explicitReads = new Set();
const originalReadFileSync = fs.readFileSync;
fs.readFileSync = function (file, ...args) {
  const name = file instanceof URL ? fileURLToPath(file) : String(file);
  explicitReads.add(name);
  return originalReadFileSync.call(this, file, ...args);
};
syncBuiltinESMExports();
registerHooks({
  load(url, context, nextLoad) {
    if (url.startsWith('file:')) {
      const filename = fileURLToPath(url);
      if (!filename.startsWith(sourceRoot + '/')) throw new Error('Outside assigned source: ' + filename);
      loadedFiles.add(filename);
    } else if (!url.startsWith('node:')) {
      throw new Error('Unsupported import: ' + url);
    }
    return nextLoad(url, context);
  },
});
const { evaluateWorkingTree } = await import(sourceRoot + '/_refs/orchestration/execution-contract.mjs');

  A: { unrelated_dirty_paths: ['src'], intended_output_paths: ['src/**'] },
  B: { unrelated_dirty_paths: ['notes.md'], intended_output_paths: ['src/category.mjs'] },
};
const results = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(inputs).map(([unit, input]) => [unit, evaluateWorkingTree(input)]));
fs.writeFileSync(runDir + '/outputs/helper-results.json', JSON.stringify(results, null, 2) + '\n');
fs.writeFileSync(runDir + '/runtime-read-log.json', JSON.stringify({ loadedFiles: [...loadedFiles].sort(), explicitReads: [...explicitReads].sort() }, null, 2) + '\n');

EOF
